resolve: Resolve `specifier` relative to `parentURL`, which must be a WHATWG `URL` instance. `readPackage` is called with a `URL` instance for every package manifest to be read and must either return the parsed JSON package manifest, if it exists, or `null`. If `readPackage` returns a promise, synchronous iteration is not supported.
ResolveOptions: `hosts` lists the `<platform>-<arch>[-<environment>]` combinations to look for prebuilds under, such as `Bare.Addon.host` in Bare. `host` is shorthand for a list of one. Added in v1.11.0: a host that starts with `wasi-` is a WebAssembly host. It is looked up after the native hosts and linked addons, as `.wasm` files whatever `extensions` is. See [`resolve.directory`](#resolvedirectory). Changed in v1.12.0: a host is split into conditions with [`bare-host-parser`](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-host-parser), so an architecture that contains a `-` stays whole, such as `arm64-32` in `watchos-arm64-32`. A host it doesn't recognize is still split at every `-`.
